explanation.headline: Divalproex sodium is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; the label for the product we hold names Coupler LLC, a repack plant with multiple OAI inspections and a 2020-09-15 Warning Letter

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include divalproex sodium as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 209 tablets of the 500 mg presentation, which at 8.1 tablets per day provides 25.7 days on hand.
The product label (NDC 67046164703) identifies Coupler LLC as the repack plant (FEI 3003734940).
FDA inspection records for that plant show OAI classifications on 2018-04-27, 2020-03-10, and 2021-08-12, with a Warning Letter issued on 2020-09-15.
The most recent inspection (2026-03-02) was classified VAI.
The ranked alternate manufacturer option is to buy from Atlantic Biologicals Corp., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.
Because the drug is not listed as short, the buyer should verify current allocation status with Atlantic Biologicals Corp. and monitor FDA inspection updates for Coupler LLC.
